description: A senior undergraduate is preparing to apply for a CS master's program in the US. They need to learn about application procedures, document preparation, timelines, costs, and standardized tests. All school and program names are fictional.

user_profile.context: Just decided to pursue a master's abroad, 6 months until deadline
user_profile.communication_style: Prefers step-by-step lists, tends to get anxious

fact_sheet.fact: The application deadline for the MS in Computer Science program at the University of Northern Westhaven (UNW) for Fall 2025 admission is December 15, 2024, at 11:59 PM PST.
The application deadline for the MS in Computer Science program at Pacific Coast Institute of Technology (PCIT) is January 5, 2025.
All applications to UNW, PCIT, and Midwest State University (MSU) must be submitted through the GradApply Central portal at https://apply.gradapplycentral.org.
The non-refundable application fee for PCIT is $95, payable by credit card via the GradApply Central portal.
For questions about the UNW application, contact the graduate admissions coordinator, Maria Garcia, at m.garcia@unw.edu.
The MS in CS program at UNW requires exactly three letters of recommendation.
Recommenders must submit their letters directly through a unique link sent to them from the GradApply Central portal after the applicant enters their contact information.
The Statement of Purpose for the University of Northern Westhaven should be a maximum of 1000 words, double-spaced, using a 12-point Times New Roman font.
All applicants with degrees from outside the US must submit a course-by-course credential evaluation from Global Credential Evaluators (GCE).

Official transcripts must be sent directly from your undergraduate institution to the graduate admissions office of each university; electronic submission to grad.transcripts@pcit.edu is preferred by PCIT.
The resume submitted to PCIT should be a single page and highlight at least two significant software development projects, including links to their Git repositories.
The 'Supplemental Document' required by Midwest State University is a 500-word essay on 'Your most challenging technical project and what you learned from it.'
To order a GCE evaluation, create an account at www.gce-eval.com, pay the $205 fee for the 'Course-by-Course with GPA' package, and follow their instructions for sending transcripts.
The estimated annual tuition and fees for the MS in CS program at the University of Northern Westhaven for the 2025-2026 academic year is $48,500.
The estimated annual living cost for a graduate student in Westhaven, including housing, food, and transport, is $22,000.
The 'Future Innovators in Tech' Scholarship offered by PCIT provides a one-time award of $10,000; the application essay is due by November 30, 2024.
To receive the I-20 form required for a student visa, applicants must show proof of funds totaling at least $70,500 for UNW, which covers one year of tuition and living expenses.
A proof of funds document must be an official bank statement from Global Citizen Bank or a similar institution, dated within the last 3 months.
Admitted students to PCIT must pay a non-refundable enrollment deposit of $500 by April 15, 2025, to secure their spot.
The standard 9-month Teaching Assistantship at Midwest State University includes a full tuition waiver and a monthly stipend of $2,200.
The University of Northern Westhaven requires a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 100, with no less than 22 on each sub-section.
Pacific Coast Institute of Technology recommends a GRE Quantitative Reasoning score of 165 or higher for competitive applicants.
The fee to send an official GRE score report to one university is $35, payable on the ETS website.
The registration fee for the TOEFL iBT test is $245.
GRE and TOEFL tests must be registered for on the official ETS website at www.ets.org.
Official GRE scores are valid for 5 years from the test date.
Midwest State University will waive the GRE requirement for international applicants whose undergraduate institution has a global ranking in the top 100 on the QS World University Rankings.
To ensure scores are received by the December 15th deadline, the final GRE attempt should be no later than November 20, 2024.
It is recommended to contact potential recommenders and provide them with your resume and statement of purpose by October 15, 2024.
Decision notifications for Fall admission at PCIT are typically sent out between March 1st and March 31st.
After accepting an offer and submitting proof of funds, the I-20 form from the University of Northern Westhaven takes approximately 3-4 weeks to be processed and mailed.
